feat(mcp-server): add image support to codex and codex-reply tools

Add an optional `images` field to both `codex` and `codex-reply` MCP
tools, enabling clients to pass image URLs (HTTP/HTTPS) or base64 data
URIs alongside text prompts for multimodal interactions.
